Block Wars is a Minecraft YouTuber tournament organized by Wolfeei and Capollo Media. Eight teams of five compete in a series of Minecraft minigames. The tournament's first season, "Series 1," began on November 21, 2020. It's fourth and current season, "Chapter 1: Seasons of Sprout," began on March 28, 2026.
There are two main Block Wars events that are hosted. Block Wars, which features a cast of established content creators, and Block Wars Origins, which features the original cast of players from the first two series, as well as smaller content creators.
Gameplay
The event features eight teams of five players. These teams will face off in eight minigames that test a variety of Minecraft skills, such as parkour, combat, building, and teamwork. Based on their performance, teams will earn points in each minigame.
At the end of the event, the two teams with the most points face off in a finale game. The team who wins the finale game is crowned the winner of the event.
